COMPONENT.Title: Clipboard
COMPONENT.Description: Use the current clipboard content, you can copy, paste and get information.

Action.Label: Action
Action.Description: The parameter indicates the action to be executed, which are COPY, PASTE, GET_DATA

Type.Label: Type
Type.Description: The parameter indicates the type of procedure, it can be VALUE, TEXT, FILE, SCREEN CAPTURE, SHORT SCREEN CAPTURE

Value.Label: Value
Value.Description: The parameter defines the path, text to copy the file or paste text into a window
